newsitem.title: UK: VICKERS DISPOSES OF U.S. UNIT FOR $14 MLN.
newsitem.headline: VICKERS DISPOSES OF U.S. UNIT FOR $14 MLN.

text.p: UK engineering group Vickers Plc said on Friday it sold its U.S. unit Jered Brown Brothers Inc for $14.3 million to Jered Industries Inc, a new company formed by a private investment group and members of Jered management.
Vickers said in a statement that the proceeds from the sale -- of which $7.3 million will be in cash and $7 million in loan notes -- will be used for general working capital purposes.
Jered Brown, acquired by Vickers in 1980, specialises in naval and commercial systems design, engineering, manufacturing and service.
